capabilities: Execute code blocks through user-registered interpreters
Register languages with executable paths, flags and preambles
Highlight code blocks with Shiki languages and themes
Configure per-block settings like line numbers, input fields and run/stop/copy buttons
Embed language and settings inline in the first line of a block
extras: The README warns that the plugin will execute programs defined by the user and that you should never run code you do not understand or trust; also notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian code blocks are static text; there is no built-in way to execute them or customize their highlighting and controls per block.

relations.evidence: Shiki, used for Syntax highlighting in rendered Codeblocks

summary: Code-block enhancer that runs code in user-registered interpreter languages and styles code blocks with Shiki highlighting and per-block settings.
